content: Local PF apps split into ledger-first (Firefly III: balances derived from transactions; liability account types for credit) vs snapshot-first (Ghostfolio AccountBalance history; periodic manual balances). For occasional net-worth updates without transaction categorization, store dated balance snapshots as source of truth and carry-forward latest snapshot as-of date; defer double-entry. Fintech 'balance_snapshots' as cache of ledger sums is a different pattern — do not conflate with user-authored snapshots.
